apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 192 fixes HUD metrics reverting after leaving/returning and reconnect requests adopting a reduced server listing. Live controls synchronize to active-session settings; startup repairs stale HUD snapshots. Reconnecting a matching retained allocation preserves its selected video request (including 2560×1080/120 FPS), while unrelated remote sessions still adopt their profile. Metal 4, vibration, controller views and other retained features are unchanged. 226 simulator tests passed, one hardware-only skip; fresh Release archive and app/widget metadata verified. Start a fresh selected-resolution session if an older build already saved a downgraded request. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
